scope: Fix ledge departure/coyote jump using the same body-footprint support as movement
Move Eden touch Fight toggle to lower action controls
Add direct mobile Beyond Eden Open Match entry, combat HUD and return to Eden
Enable charged momentum and its HUD only in arenas
Apply phone graphics settings in landscape as well as portrait

measurement.emulation: 844x390, DPR 3, coarse pointer, five touch points, renderer CPU throttled 4x
measurement.interpretation: These are diagnostic desktop emulation samples, not physical phone FPS. Dynamic residents, streamed asset completion and camera transitions change the workload between runs, so these runs do not establish a percentage speedup. The final run still has slow frames under CPU throttling; this is not a no-hitch guarantee.

changes_in_render_budget.response: Only sustained pressure lowers resolution; isolated loading hitches do not permanently blur the scene.

known_limits: Real Safari/iPhone and Android hardware still need a play session.
Beyond Eden Open Match remains its existing pistol/bot/page mode; this change does not introduce a new internet PvP backend.
